Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?

Combining two separate orders into one shipment isn't something our system supports. Each order ships on its own once it goes into production.

If one of the orders was placed within the last 4 hours, you could cancel it and fold those items into the other order instead.

turns.q: Will I get an email confirmation once the change is made?
turns.replyTail:
onfirmation once the change is made?

There's no confirmation email for a change, because changes aren't actually made to the order. The system doesn't edit orders, it only cancels them.

So the flow is: you cancel within the 4-hour window, then place a new order with what you want. You'd get a fresh order confirmation email for the new order, and the cancellation itself shows in your account under Orders.
